PRIVACY POLICY AND LEGAL NOTICE

I. PRIVACY POLICY

In accordance with REGULATION (EU) 2016/679 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and Organic Law 3/2018 of 5 December on Personal Data Protection and the guarantee of digital rights, you are informed that personal data you provide through cinederiesgo.com (hereinafter, the website) will be processed under the following terms:

Data controller

Personal data collected through this website will be processed by CINE DE RIESGO, S.L.U. Requests to exercise your rights may be sent to C/ Alba De Tormes N85, Colmenar Viejo, 28770 Madrid.

Purposes of processing

To inform you about our products and services when you request this through the website forms or by email.

To respond to and manage your inquiries, comments and suggestions, where applicable.

To manage your participation in current and future recruitment processes when you send us your data, including your résumé, for that purpose.

To understand use of the website, we analyze pages viewed, visit counts, visitor activity and frequency of use. For these purposes, the CONTROLLER uses statistical information prepared by the Internet Service Provider that does not identify the individual at any time.

Legal basis

Consent. Personal data obtained through website forms will be processed solely on the basis of the consent given by the individual through acceptance of the checkbox provided for that purpose. This consent may be withdrawn at any time.

The controller’s legitimate interest. Statistical information obtained from the website will be processed on the basis of the controller’s legitimate interest. This information does not identify the user.

Recipients

Personal data obtained through the website will not be disclosed to third parties unless required by law.

Retention

Personal data provided to receive marketing communications will be retained until the individual requests deletion or withdraws consent.

When users provide personal data to participate in the CONTROLLER’s recruitment processes, it will be processed for current selection processes. If not selected, their personal data will be retained for two years so they may be considered for future processes.

When users provide data to contact the CONTROLLER or submit inquiries or suggestions, it will be retained for as long as necessary for that purpose and while liabilities arising from the processing may exist. Traffic, statistical and website visit data will be retained for three years.

Rights

You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure and portability, and restriction of and objection to processing, by sending a written request with an official identification document to C/ Alba De Tormes N85, Colmenar Viejo 28770 Madrid. If you disagree with the processing, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

Protection of minors

Anyone who provides data through this website’s forms and accepts its processing formally declares that they are over 14 years old.

Access to and use of the website by children under 14 is prohibited.

The CONTROLLER reminds adults responsible for minors that they bear sole responsibility if a minor provides personal data to request a product.

Software is also available to limit browsing by filtering or blocking particular content.

Processing arising from social media use

By following our social media profiles, you expressly consent to the processing of your personal data in accordance with the relevant social network’s privacy policy. You also expressly consent to the CONTROLLER accessing and processing data in your profile and to news about its products appearing on your feed. Your connection request necessarily implies consent to that processing, which constitutes its legal basis. Data will be retained until you object or withdraw consent; you may do so at any time.

Comments and content published on social media become public information, so users should take particular care when sharing personal information. The CONTROLLER is not responsible for information users publish on the page. Nevertheless, people whose personal data is published or included in comments may request its removal from the CONTROLLER.
